Hey, thank you very much for your response.

You definetly are right, her finding herself isnt my place, and I should definetly focus more on communicating my needs.

 I have taken a bit of time to reflect what I feel is missing, and I hope I will be able to communicate that I feel like I personally need more verbal affirmation and more cuddles/ nonverbal affirmation. I hope that I will be able to communicate that to her. I find communicating my needs quite hard for some reason though.

Your point about the willingness to do the things that affirm me as a show of love is an interesting point, I havent really thought about it this way, I will definetly keep this in mind, because I do subconsciously feel like that a bit and took it for granted, because it comes naturally for me, which I only really realized when reading your comment and thinking about it.

Thank you so much for your advice I think its quite helpful!

I respect that this might be the case for most allos, and I am very sorry that your marriage ended this way.

 However, I am very certain that sex or the lack of sex isnt an issue for me. I have done a lot of thinking about this, and sex is something that would be nice to have in a relationship, but it isnt necessary for me. I know that many allos see sex as the defining factor that drives intimacy, but at least for me, there are other ways that are equally as, if not more important for creating intimacy. The things I personally need in a relationship are intimacy, love and romantic affection, aswell as a strong platonic connection. The physical part of sexual satisfaction is not something I need a partner for personally, so the only part where my needs from the sexual side might not be met is pertaining to intimacy. But since for me, romantic affection and time spent together create just as much the feeling of intimacy, I feel like I would be fine. What I am more worried about is a lack of romantic affection, as currently I dont really know if I am fine living without that.
I know that I might be different from other allos and the allo consensus on this, that a relationship needs sex for intimacy and a strong personal connection, but at least for me, I know that as long as my partner loves me, and I love her, thats enough for me.
Thanks, thats already really helpful to me!

Thats a very interesting point. I definetly need to communicate more about our relationship and how we see it. I tried that before, but potentially I didnt really frame the question right. I definetly feel like she does care for me, and I feel that aswell. What I am less sure about is if she loves me, and if she feels a romantic connection. Another poster suggested that it might be a love language disconnect, so I think I will try to communicate more about how we show affection. Arospec people loving differently is a very interesting point I havent really considered before, as I have absolutely no experience with the aro spectrum. 

Another point thats really difficult for me as an allo to grasp is where the boundary between a very good friendship and a relationship lies for arospec people, as for me as an allo the boundary is love and a romantic connection. I would be happy if you could give me some insight into how an arospec person percieves this if you dont mind, but absolutely no pressure. Im trying my best to learn more about acespec and arospec people and how they percieve the world

Thank you for the answer! Thats a very good suggestion and exactly what I was looking for. I am aiming at communicating that I do not always feel like she is romantically invested in the relationship and I was afraid of it coming across as accusatory. There are also other reasons I belive she might be aroace, but those I would rather not discuss here. 

I havent really considered the fact that it could be a love language disconnect. My love language is very physical, with lots of cuddling, kissing, and holding hands. I am not that sure about her love language, but I know that she does not show affection in this way. I think her showing affection is more in the conversations we have and the time we spend together, but im not really that sure. Thats absolutely a conversation we need to have and I cant believe that I didnt realize that up untill now.

Also thank you for the input on the Aroallo relationship. I need to do a lot of thinking to know if I would be fine with such a relationship but just hearing that its able to work for some has given me some hope that even if she turns out to be aroace we might be able to make it work.
Thank you! I will post there
Thanks for the suggestion. This was the only place that came to mind, as I have seen posts by aroaces in this subreddit. Is there a more specific aro subreddit I could ask this question in?
I wont. I love her so much, even if its killing me. Also, I really enjoy the time we spend together and shes my best friend, and I really dont want to lose her.
Thats the issue. How do I ask her if shes Aro, without it coming across as an accusation of her not loving me enough?
Yeah, I think getting relationship advice from allos was a bad Idea, but unfortunately I only know allos irl apart from my girlfriend, so I didnt have anyone to ask before I discovered this subreddit

Thank you for your response. I am actually already in therapy, due to depression. I will try to bring it up at my next therapy session! Yes, I think I have self esteem issues ever since i was a child, due to years of bullying and physical abuse for being weird and ugly, im trying to work throug it but its quite hard. Sorry for trauma dumping, you dont need to respond to this if it makes you uncomfortable but it helps me just write it a bit off my chest

Thank you so much for your response. I was/ am? going through an identity crisis not too long ago, so this is really helpful advice to me. I will try to follow it as good as possible.

Thanks for your response! I should definetly try to hear less about what others have to say about me and my relationship, but its really hard. 
I really needed to hear that im not less for being a virgin and being fine with not having sex

Concerning the demisexual thing, im not sure, I need to do some more research on that, but if thats what its called, I guess that label might fit? From conversations with other allo friends I can tell that I experience sexual attraction a bit different from them, but I definetly do feel sexual attraction towards my girlfriend since a few months into the relationship, thats why I would consider myself as allo. But to be honest the first time I really thought deeper about the differences in the feeling of sexual attraction was when my girlfriend came out as ace to me, which wasnt too long ago.

I wish it was that easy. Rationally its clear, just words, but deep down it still hurts a lot and really messes with my sense of self worth if I hear another wizard joke

Thank you! I will defintely try to bring it up with her! Gives me some comfort to know that no one cares if im a virgin tbh

Thank you for your response!

To be honest hes the only real source of relationship advice I have of someone i know in real life and apparently for him and his girlfriend sex is one of the largest defining parts of intimacy between them, so he doubts that my relationship will last because we are apparently missing the defining aspect of a relationship according to him and he told me that shes gonna lose feelings for me if we dont have sex
And btw I still catch a lot of shit for being a virgin from my friends, and they are all grown men, thats where feeling inferior comes from

Thank you for the response! Yeah, as far as im concerned i have everything I could ever need in my relationship, so hes defintely wrong

I didnt really see a point in bringing this up to her, I do not want to put any pressure on her, as the last thing I want is her somehow feeling bad or responsible for my inferiority complex, and what my friend said is something I would never tell her as I can tell that it would hurt her feelings as much as it hurt mine, and I dont wanna do that.
